brand.core_concept: The Editor's Desk - presenting properties as curated lifestyle narratives, not just database entries.

primary.name: Spiced Clay (Brand Accent)
primary.usage: Primary Actions, Active States, Highlights (Use sparingly like a Hermès box)

headings.usage: All H1-H6 tags. Avoid Bold (700+) unless absolutely necessary. Let the serif do the work.

buttons.primary: bg-[#EA580C] text-white hover:bg-[#C2410C] rounded-none h-12 px-8 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold transition-all hover:tracking-[0.2em]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-stone-900 text-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-900 hover:text-white rounded-none h-12 px-8 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold transition-all

cards.property: group relative bg-white border border-stone-200 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-500 rounded-none
cards.feature: bg-stone-50 p-8 border border-stone-100 hover:bg-white hover:border-stone-200 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-stone-300 px-0 py-3 rounded-none focus:border-[#EA580C] focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-stone-400 font-manrope text-lg

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-100 h-20
navigation.link: text-stone-500 hover:text-[#EA580C] uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold transition-colors

visual_enhancers.noise: opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[9999] mix-blend-overlay

hero.alt: Luxury modern home exterior at dusk

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on #EA580C backgrounds is White. Text on #FAFAF9 must be #1C1917 or #78716C.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-label for all icon-only buttons (like WhatsApp float).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-stone-900).

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to extend colors with the new 'Stone' based palette. Use CSS variables in index.css.
REFACTOR /app/frontend/src/App.css: Replace @apply .btn-primary with reusable Tailwind classes in components. Keep the .noise-bg class.
MODIFY Typography: Ensure Playfair Display is used for Headings (font-normal) and Manrope for Body.
UPDATE Components: Refine the PropertyCard to remove heavy shadows and use the 'Clean Slate' style (border-stone-200).
LAYOUT: Implement the 'Bento' grid for the featured section and the 'Horizontal Scroll' for mobile listings.
CRITICAL: Preserve all data-testid attributes and RTL support functionality.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing (py-24, py-32) than standard templates.
Never use 'Inter' for headings. Use Playfair Display.
Avoid gradients for backgrounds unless it's a subtle overlay.
All interactive elements must have micro-interactions (hover, scale, color shift).
